spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Doric casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Doric makes two Shaped Claw or Sling attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Shaped Claw
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, portée 30/120 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoningdgts.

bonus.name: Change Shape (5/Day)
entries: Doric magically transforms into a Beast with a challenge rating of 3 or less or into an owlbear (see the Monster Manual).

Doric can remain in that form for up to 2 hours. She can choose whether her equipment falls to the ground, melds with her new form, or is worn by the new form. Doric reverts to her true form if she is {@condition incapacitated} or dies. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action.

While Doric is transformed, her stat block is replaced by the stat block of that form, except she keeps her current hit points, her hit point maximum, this bonus action, her alignment, and her Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

reaction.name: Fiery Rebuke (3/Day)
entries: When Doric is damaged by a creature that she can see within 60 feet of herself, she magically engulfs the creature in flames. The creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Edgin casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Edgin makes two Reinforced Lute or Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Reinforced Lute
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoningdgts plus 11 ({@dégât 2d10}) thunderdgts.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d6 + 3}) piercingdgts plus 11 ({@dégât 2d10}) thunderdgts.

action.name: Disorienting Words
entries: Edgin magically taunts up to three creatures he can see within 60 mètres of himself. Each creature doit réussir on a {@dd 15}Sagesse saving throw or take 10 ({@dégât 3d6}) psychicdgts and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Edgin's next turn.

reaction.name: Inspiring Words (3/Day)
entries: When a creature Edgin can see within 60 feet of himself fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, Edgin grants the creature magical encouragement. The creature can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled to the total, potentially turning the failure into a success.

trait.name: Disarming Charm
entries: While Forge isn't wearing armor, his AC includes hisCharisme modifier.

trait.name: Double-Cross
entries: If Forgetouchés une créature friendly to him with an attack roll, the attack is automatically a criticaltouché.

trait.name: Évasion
entries: If Forge is subjected to an effect that allows him to make aDextérité saving throw to take only halfdgts, he takes nodgts if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only halfdgts if he fails, provided he isn't {@conditionincapacité}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Forge makes two Dagger attacks, two Heavy Crossbow attacks, or one of each.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 20/60 m,, une cible. {@h}4 ({@dégât 1d4 + 2}) piercingdgts plus 24 ({@dégât 7d6}) poisondgts, and la cible is {@condition empoisonné} until la fin de son prochain tour.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, portée 100/400 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d10 + 2}) piercingdgts plus 24 ({@dégât 7d6}) poisondgts. {@hom}If la cible is une créature, it désavantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of Forge's next turn.

bonus.name: Cunning
entries: Forge takes the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action, or he gives himself advantage on the next attack roll he makes before the end of this turn.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: Forge halves the damage he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

trait.name: Téméraire
entries: At the start of her turn, Holga can gain advantage on melee weapaux jets d'attaque during that turn, but attack rolls against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Holga carries a darksteel greataxe, a magic weapon that grants her resistance to lightningdgts while she carries it (included above).

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While Holga isn't wearing armor, her AC includes herConstitution modifier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Holga makes three Darksteel Greataxe or Improvised Weapon attacks, in any combination.

action.name: Darksteel Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}10 ({@dégât 1d12 + 4}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Improvised Weapon
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, or portée 20/60 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts.

bonus.name: Wrestle
entries: Holga shoves a creature within 5 feet of herself. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet into an unoccupied space of Holga's choice.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1, Simon must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook. On a roll of 2 or higher, Simon casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):
will: {@spell speak with dead} (Simon must be holding his deathly token to cast this spell)

trait.name: Ascendance féerique
entries: Simon avantage aux jets de sauvegarde he makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmé} condition on himself, and magic can't put him to sleep.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Simon carries a {@item bag of holding}, two pairs of {@item sending stones}, and a deathly token (see Spellcasting).

trait.name: Wild Magic
entries: When Simon takes 20 or moredgts from a single source or takesdgts from a criticaltouché, he must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Simon makes three Quarterstaff or Chaos Bolt attacks. He can replace one attack with one use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}2 ({@dégât 1d6 - 1}) bludgeoningdgts, or 3 ({@dégât 1d8 - 1}) bludgeoningdgts if used with two hands, plus 11 ({@dégât 2d10}) forcedgts.

action.name: Chaos Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} pour toucher, portée 60 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 2d10 + 3})dgts of a random type determined by rolling a {@dice d8}: 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, force; 5, lightning; 6, poison; 7, psychic; 8, thunder.

reaction.name: Sheltering Shield (3/Day)
entries: When Simon or another creature he can see within 10 feet of himself would take damage, he conjures a shimmering, 10-foot-radius sphere of magical force centered on himself. Creatures inside the sphere have resistance to the damage that triggered this reaction.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sofina casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Sofina wears a magic robe that grants her a +2 bonus to AC and a +1 bonus to saving throws (included above).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sofina makes three Necrotic Strike attacks.

action.name: Necrotic Strike
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 10} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 120 m,, une cible. {@h}32 ({@dégât 5d10 + 5}) necroticdgts.

action.name: Swarm of Meteors (1/Day)
entries: Sofina magically calls down a meteor swarm that detonates in four 40-foot-radius spheres, each one centered on a point she can see within 480 mètres of herself. These spheres can overlap. Each creature in one or more of these spheres doit faire a {@dd 18}Dextérité saving throw, taking 35 ({@dégât 10d6}) firedgts and 35 ({@dégât 10d6}) bludgeoningdgts on a failed saving throw, or half as muchdgts on a successful one. A creature in multiple spheres takes thisdgts only once.

bonus.name: Summon Wraith (1/Day)
entries: Sofina magically summons the spirit of a Thayan assassin, which appears as a wraith (see the Monster Manual). The summoned wraith appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Sofina, whom it obeys. The summoned wraith takes its turn immediately after Sofina. It lasts for 1 hour, until it or Sofina dies, or until Sofina dismisses it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Aura of Protection
entries: Xenk and his allies within 10 mètres of him have advantage aux jets de sauvegarde.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Xenk makes three Daggersword attacks and uses Daggersword Flourish. He can replace Daggersword Flourish with Cleansing Touch if it's available.

action.name: Daggersword
entries: Choose the attack that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d8 + 4}) slashingdgts, or 9 ({@dégât 1d10 + 4}) slashingdgts if used with two hands, plus 6 ({@dégât 1d12}) radiantdgts.

action.name: Shortsword and Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) piercingdgts plus 6 ({@dégât 1d12}) radiantdgts.

action.name: Daggersword Flourish
entries: Choose the option that corresponds to the daggersword's current form (see Daggersword Shift below):

action.name: Longsword
entries: Xenk magically detaches the longsword's blade from its hilt, launching the blade at une créature he can see within 30 mètres of himself. The target doit faire a {@dd 16}Dextérité saving throw. On a failed save, la cible is impaled by the blade, taking 14 ({@dégât 3d6 + 4}) piercingdgts, and is knocked {@condition à terre}. At the end of the current turn, the blade magically reattaches to its hilt.

action.name: Shortsword and Dagger
entries: Xenk lashes out with both weapons. Each creature of his choice within 10 mètres of him doit faire a {@dd 16}Dextérité throw. On a failed save, la créature takes 7 ({@dégât 2d6}) piercingdgts and désavantage aux jets d'attaque until the start of Xenk's next turn. On a successful save, la créature takes half as muchdgts and suffers no other effect.

action.name: Cleansing Touch (1/Day)
entries: Xenk touches une créature within 5 mètres of himself. The target magically regains 27 ({@dice 6d8})touché points and gains the benefit of a {@spell lesser restoration} spell.

bonus.name: Daggersword Shift
entries: Xenk changes the form of his daggersword, choosing one of the following forms: a longsword, or a shortsword in one hand and a dagger in the other.
